title: Bergamo Lymphoid Cancer Registry
summary: This registry has been established to gain a better understanding of the clinical and biological characteristics and outcome of patients with lymphoid cancer
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female patients 18 years or older
* Written informed consent
* Confirmed diagnosis of Hodgkin disease, non-Hodgkin lymphomas or myeloma

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Unconfirmed diagnosis of Hodgkin disease, non-Hodgkin lymphomas or myeloma

sites.f: Hematology and Bone Marrow Transplant Unit, A.O. Ospedale Papa Giovanni XXIII
